features: ⌚ Daily Activity Tracking Tracks steps throughout the day to help you stay aware of movement and activity levels. Ideal for walking, workouts, office routines, and daily fitness goals without complicated settings or operation.
❤️ Heart Rate Monitoring Helps you monitor heart rate during exercise and daily activities. Useful for understanding workout intensity and staying aware of physical activity patterns during the day.
🩺 Blood Pressure Awareness Includes blood pressure monitoring to support daily health awareness. A helpful feature for users who want basic tracking alongside fitness and activity monitoring.
🌙 Sleep Monitoring Support Tracks sleep duration and activity during rest to provide insight into sleep patterns. Supports healthier daily routines by helping you understand rest quality over time.
💧 Waterproof Design Built for daily wear with a waterproof body that supports workouts, outdoor use, and light water exposure without frequent removal.
🏃 Unisex Comfortable Fit Designed for both men and women with a lightweight and skin friendly strap that remains comfortable during long hours of wear.
📊 Simple Health Insights Displays essential activity and health data in an easy to understand format, helping users stay informed without technical complexity.
🔋 Everyday Wearable Suitable for daily routines including work, walking, exercise, and casual wear, making it a practical fitness companion.
🎯 Motivation for Active Living Encourages movement and healthier habits by keeping activity data visible and easy to track throughout the day.
🌍 Ideal for All Age Groups A practical smart band for beginners and regular users who want basic fitness and health tracking in a compact wearable.
